name: Hotel Garni Pfeifer
beschreibung: Hotel Garni Pfeifer is situated in a tranquil edge-of-town location in Kirchberg in Tirol near Kitzbühel. The impressive mountain backdrop offers easy access to summer hiking trails and renowned ski domains throughout the Kitzbühel Alps in winter. Rooms feature private balconies and Wi-Fi. A fresh daily breakfast buffet showcases regional produce. Guests also enjoy a relaxing sauna, sunbathing lawn, ski storage, and private parking.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni Pfeifer in Kirchberg near Kitzbühel features peaceful bed-and-breakfast rooms with balconies, a sauna, a sun lawn, and easy access to top ski slopes.
